difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for quasi-compact quasi-separated X, a quasi-compact open U and U-admissible blowups b_i : X_i -> X, i = 1..n, there is a U-admissible blowup b : X' -> X factoring through each b_i, with each X' -> X_i again a U-admissible blowup (source lines 9150-9158). The proof passes to the finite type ideals I_i defining the blowups with vanishing locus disjoint from U, forms the product ideal I = I_1...I_n, takes the blowup X' of X in I, and concludes the factorization from the two-ideals lemma; the construction is carried out in place and the admissibility of the intermediate maps is read off from it.
